comment: Squad comms audio spec, read by tools/comms_pipeline.py. Human lines are Kokoro-82M TTS (voice + speed per cast member in cast.json); demon lines are synthesized grunts. Both go through the radio chain, are loudness-normalised and encoded to web/audio/comms/<clip id>.ogg (Opus) and .m4a (AAC-LC).

chatterbox.comment: Expressive delivery: Chatterbox (Resemble AI, MIT) clones each character's Kokoro reference clip (refs stage) and speaks every human line with the emotion's settings. exaggeration = emotion intensity (0.25 flat .. 2 extreme; 0.5 is the model default), cfg_weight = pacing/adherence (lower = faster, more animated), temperature = sampling variety. A clip that fails the accept rules falls back to the Kokoro rendering.
chatterbox.reference_text: Radio check on the fleet channel. I read you loud and clear, and the weather over the frontier is quiet tonight. Stand by for further orders, and keep this line open.

registers.comment: Derived references (hotrefs stage, optional): Chatterbox clones the neutral Kokoro reference speaking `text` at a high exaggeration and keeps the widest-pitched take that keeps the voice. Measured in v4 on 20 hot lines: no gain in pitch range over the neutral reference (10.9 vs 11.9 st), so no emotion uses it (an emotion would opt in with "ref": "hot").

hot.text: Contact, contact! They're diving right at us! Break left, break left, now! Yes! Got him! What a shot! Come on, push, push, we've got this!

chatterbox.emotions_comment: v4 (measured, plan/audio-backend.md): exaggeration up to 1.3 at cfg 0.5 (lower cfg slowed delivery and let lengths run away; the derived energetic reference did not widen pitch, so every emotion clones the neutral reference); hot emotions end sentences on "!"; `post` is the deterministic delivery stage (intonation expand around the median pitch, shift in semitones, WSOLA tempo, level-contour dynamics).

gibberish.comment: Nonsense syllables rendered by Kokoro from phonemes (never English words), then granulated and pitch/formant shifted under the growl layer.

radio.comment: v3 softer keying: levels are relative to the voice peak (1.0) before loudness normalisation. Click = rounded sine 'tock'; burst/tail = low-passed carrier noise (RMS-scaled); tone = quiet fleet key-up tone.

grunt_lengths.comment: raw_max_s caps the synthesized grunt; min_s/max_s bound the final clip (with keying lead and tail). Unlisted triggers: 0.5-1.9 s.
